_meta.baseline: master @ c38c606 (intended tag v5.1.1) + the later uncommitted fixes
_meta.claim: Exact equality on every leaf: active, phase, and three day-precision instants. Nothing here is a float on the wire.
_meta.why: The file is three scan loops, not a formula. Two of its iteration bounds are non-integral divisions that a Go int port would truncate (docs/porting.md 1.7), and findNextEntry bisects with float endpoints that a D4-style int64 port would floor. Neither shows up except at a scan or arc boundary, so the golden carries a day-by-day walk across a real boundary as well as a phase sweep.
